summary: BifrOSt embeds the Servo 0.7.0 engine out of process behind a WebProcessPool with navigation events and decisions, find, zoom, page scripts and messages, content blockers, cookies, a PDF of a page, and a developer-tools layer (JavaScript eval, PNG snapshot). Missing: WebKit for SwiftUI, WebKit's WKDOMNodeSnapshot, WebDriver, Safari-specific web-author pages, and web extensions; several WKWebView behaviours are stubbed or absent (stopLoading, custom user agent on a running view, per-world scripts, navigation response policy, context menus).

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (WebProcessPool, WebViewId, WebViewState); wired: springboard/apps/browser/src/main.rs (menus, menu_action: View > Zoom In, Zoom Out, Actual Size); springboard/apps/browser/src/session.rs (zoom_by); springboard/sdk/src/web_config.rs (WebViewConfiguration, WebPreferences); springboard/sdk/src/web_bridge.rs (WebProcessPool::install_configuration, wrap_user_script); springboard/apps/browser/engine/src/devtools.rs (set_user_script)
features.note: 2026-10-19: the configuration now reaches the engine. install_configuration sends the message bridge and the app's user scripts as a document-start script slot that every view runs (AtDocumentEnd after DOMContentLoaded, main frame only when asked, each in its own function scope), replacing an earlier install; the Browser installs its configuration when the engine starts. Still missing: ContentMode, HTTPS upgrade policy as a preference, preferences are not read by the engine (javascript_enabled, minimum_font_size), no per-view or per-world scripts. Midget check: `browser.eval` `typeof window.bifrost.messageHandlers.control.postMessage` on a freshly loaded page returns "function" (MCP browser tool eval); host tests `web_bridge::tests::user_scripts_are_scoped_and_timed` and `a_configuration_installs_its_bridge_before_its_scripts`.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (WebViewEvent: LoadStarted, LoadCommitted, LoadFinished, HistoryChanged; go_back, go_forward, reload); wired: springboard/apps/browser/src/tabdiscard.rs (history_menu, jump_to, jump_step); springboard/apps/browser/src/main.rs (menus, menu_action); springboard/sdk/src/web_nav.rs (NavigationDelegate, PolicyBroker, BackForwardList); springboard/sdk/src/web_bridge.rs (NavigationRouter, navigation_decisions, WebProcessPool::set_navigation_policy_enabled, navigation_reply); springboard/apps/browser/engine/src/blocker.rs (hold, answer)
features.note: 2026-10-19: NavigationDelegate decisions are wired to the engine. With set_navigation_policy_enabled(true) the engine holds every navigation (WebViewDelegate::request_navigation) and reports WebViewEvent::NavigationRequested; navigation_reply, answer_navigation_requests (synchronous delegate) or NavigationRouter (late answers, allow after DECISION_TIMEOUT_MS) sends allow, cancel or download. The engine cannot tell the frame or the cause, so every request is a main-frame request of unknown type; there is no navigation response policy hook; stop_loading is still a no-op because Servo 0.7.0 cannot cancel a load; the Browser does not enable the policy round trip (it uses content rules for blocking). Midget check: `browser.content_rules` op compile with identifier "nav" and rules [{"trigger":{"url-filter":"^https://example\\.org/"},"action":{"type":"block"}}], then `browser.navigate` to https://example.org/ does not load it (the engine denies the navigation in request_navigation); host tests `web_bridge::tests::the_delegate_decides_each_requested_navigation` and `slow_decisions_resolve_to_allow_at_the_deadline`.

features.feature: Web data management (cookies, website data, URL scheme handling)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (profile directory passed to WebProcessPool::spawn); springboard/sdk/src/web_data.rs (CookieStore, WebsiteDataStore); springboard/sdk/src/web_bridge.rs (request_cookies, reconcile_cookies, set_page_cookie, clear_engine_cookies, cookie_set_script)
features.note: 2026-10-19: the engine jar and CookieStore can be synchronised. request_cookies asks the engine for the cookies of a view's page URL (HttpOnly included, via site_data_manager().cookies_for_url) and answers WebViewEvent::Cookies; reconcile_cookies adds and updates them in a CookieStore and removes the cookies the engine no longer has; set_page_cookie writes a cookie through the page's document.cookie (not HttpOnly); clear_engine_cookies deletes all. Still missing: the engine answers for one page URL at a time, no engine call sets an HttpOnly cookie, no change notification (HTTPCookieStoreObserver), no custom URL scheme handler, the Browser does not call these yet. Midget check: host tests `web_bridge::tests::engine_cookies_parse_and_reconcile_with_the_store` and `page_cookies_are_written_as_cookie_strings`; the engine side is `cookies ID TOKEN` in apps/browser/engine/src/main.rs (a Browser hook is not wired, so no Midget click path yet).

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/web_download.rs (WebDownload, WebDownloadDelegate, ResumeData, navigation_response_policy), springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (WebViewEvent::DownloadStarted); springboard/ui/src/download.rs, springboard/ui/src/nav_policy.rs; wired: springboard/apps/browser/src/main.rs (menus, menu_action: File > Show Downloads, Clear Finished Downloads); springboard/apps/browser/src/downloads.rs; springboard/sdk/src/web_bridge.rs (suggested_filename); springboard/apps/browser/engine/src/blocker.rs (answer: download)
features.note: 2026-10-19: the engine now emits DownloadStarted: when the app answers a NavigationRequested with Download the engine cancels the navigation and reports `download ID URL`, which the pool turns into WebViewEvent::DownloadStarted with a file name taken from the URL path. Still missing: choosing downloads from response headers (no hook in request_navigation), the Browser still uses its own download model (downloads.rs). Midget check: host tests `web_bridge::tests::download_names_come_from_the_url_path` and `the_delegate_decides_each_requested_navigation`; the Browser path is unchanged: File > Show Downloads.

features.apple: WKUserContentController, WKUserScript, WKContentWorld, WKJSHandle, WKContentRuleListStore, WKFrameInfo
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview_dev.rs (dev_eval, dev_collector as document-start script); springboard/sdk/src/web_config.rs (UserContentController, UserScript, ScriptMessageHandler, ScriptMessage); springboard/sdk/src/web_bridge.rs (parse_script_message, route_script_messages, POST_EXPRESSION); springboard/apps/browser/src/webbridge.rs (Bridge, control handler); springboard/apps/browser/engine/src/blocker.rs (script_message_line)
features.note: 2026-10-19: page to app messages work end to end. A page calls window.bifrost.messageHandlers.<name>.postMessage(value); the engine turns the bridge's console line into `scriptmsg`, the pool reports WebViewEvent::ScriptMessage, route_script_messages delivers it to the UserContentController handler registered under the name; the Browser registers a `control` handler whose log is `browser.messages`. User scripts are installed by install_configuration. Still missing: per-world isolation, replies from the app to a page other than eval, message bodies over 60 KB are dropped, a posting frame is told only as main or not. Midget check: `browser.eval` `window.bifrost.messageHandlers.control.postMessage({a:1})` on a page loaded after the Browser started, then `browser.messages` returns an entry with name "control" and body {"a":1} (MCP browser tool); host tests `web_bridge::tests::a_posted_message_survives_the_trip_from_the_page_to_the_handler` and `webbridge::tests::a_page_message_is_logged_with_its_tab_and_read_back_once`.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (WebProcessPool::find, find_clear, WebViewState::find_matches); wired: springboard/apps/browser/src/main.rs (menus, menu_action: View > Find in Page, Find Next, Find Previous); springboard/apps/browser/src/findbar.rs; springboard/sdk/src/web_config.rs (FindConfiguration, FindResult, FindSession, find_matches)
features.note: injected script count only; no highlight, no match index, no case or whole-word options Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity. Case-sensitive and backwards options, match index and wrap are modelled and host-tested; the engine find script does not use them yet.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview_dev.rs (dev_screenshot to PNG, ShotMode View/Rect/Full); springboard/sdk/src/web_print.rs (PrintLayout, plan_pages, pdf_from_rgb); springboard/apps/browser/src/resample.rs (png_to_pdf); springboard/apps/browser/src/control.rs (pdf_reply)
features.note: 2026-10-19: PDF output exists. web_print cuts the full-page snapshot into pages scaled to the paper width (Letter or A4, margins, title and "Page n of m"), written with the SDK PDF writer; the Browser exposes it as `browser.screenshot` with format "pdf". Still missing: the PDF holds the page as pictures (no selectable text, no print CSS, no element-aware page breaks), PNG snapshot scale is the view's device scale, Full still resizes the rendering context briefly. Midget check: `browser.screenshot` {"full_page":true,"format":"pdf","paper":"a4"} returns format pdf with base64 data and a `pages` count; save the data to a file and open it in the PDF app; host tests `web_print::tests::the_pdf_has_one_sized_page_per_slice_with_title_and_numbers` and `browser resample::tests::a_png_prints_as_a_paginated_pdf`.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 6 (b08, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. no right click or context menu; the engine path does not expose link info

features.feature: Web UI delegate (alerts, file panels, new windows, window features)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (CreateWebView, Closed, Dialog, Menu, FilePicker, ColorPicker, UnloadRequested and typed replies); springboard/apps/browser/src/pageui.rs; springboard/apps/browser/src/uploads.rs; springboard/sdk/src/web_config.rs
features.note: 2026-10-19: Servo 0.7 native alerts, confirm, prompt, context/select menus, file inputs, RGB color inputs and navigation beforeunload requests are integrated. File selection uses the SDK document portal and private staging copies off the UI thread, with 64 files/1 GiB per selection and 2 GiB retained per window. Unresolved unload confirmations explicitly deny; direct tab close and quit do not prompt. Native window.open uses the provided WebViewBuilder. Not checked on Midget; window feature placement, IME and complete web UI parity remain gaps. No new automated tests run in this round.

features.apple: Keyboard and pointer events in WKWebView, UIKit-hosted scrolling, appearance
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (touch, key, set_dark, set_frame, set_zoom, set_viewport_override)
features.note: no hover and no drag text selection; zoom is clamped 30 to 500 percent; the desktop pointer is delivered as touch
the configuration computes the user agent for engine start; Servo reads it at start-up only, so a change on a running view is not applied.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/content_rule_lists.rs (ContentRuleList, ContentRuleListStore, ContentRuleLists, hide_script); springboard/sdk/src/rule_match.rs (UrlFilter, RuleSet, Verdict); springboard/sdk/src/web_bridge.rs (WebProcessPool::set_content_rules); springboard/apps/browser/engine/src/blocker.rs (load_web_resource and request_navigation); wired: springboard/apps/browser/src/webbridge.rs (browser.content_rules)
features.note: 2026-10-19: the reference's JSON rule lists compile (all six action types, all trigger keys, the url-filter regular-expression subset with anchors, classes, groups and counted repeats; alternation, lazy quantifiers and back references are refused), are kept in <profile>/content-rules/ and applied to every view. The engine blocks web resource loads and navigations itself (block), upgrades http navigations (make-https) and a generated page script hides elements (css-display-none). Still missing: block-cookies and notify have no engine hook (compiled and reported by ContentRuleLists::evaluate only), load-type uses a two-label site comparison, one rule set for all views. Midget check: `browser.content_rules` op compile identifier "t" rules [{"trigger":{"url-filter":"example\\.org"},"action":{"type":"block"}}], then `browser.content_rules` op test url https://example.org/a resource image returns block true, `browser.navigate` to https://example.org/ does not load, and `browser.network` shows the blocked subresource requests of a page that embeds one; host tests `rule_match::tests::*`, `content_rule_lists::tests::a_reference_style_list_compiles_and_judges_requests`, `webbridge::tests::compiled_lists_are_stored_applied_tested_and_removed`.

gaps: No WebDriver implementation for web content (Apple's WebDriver commands for Safari); the testing kit is XCTest-style only.
No WKDOMNodeSnapshot equivalent: no DOM tree snapshot object.
No navigation policy callback (per-request allow or cancel), and stop_loading does nothing because Servo 0.7.0 cannot cancel a load.
No alert, confirm, prompt or file-chooser UI delegate, and no select element support.
No page-to-app message handler (WKScriptMessageHandler equivalent) and no content rule lists.
No cookie or website-data API (WKHTTPCookieStore, WKWebsiteDataStore) for apps.
custom user agent is not applied: Servo reads it at start-up only.
No PDF snapshot output and no context menu support.
